interpretation: Clothing contains body with ease; no symmetric IoU threshold. Exposed body well outside garment cannot be explained by ease. Hair excluded by regional crops. ImageGen is weak illustrative cue, not ground truth.
veto: Any critical region failure vetoes 2D visual PASS; functional integrity and 3D plausibility are separate, never averaged.

pose_cues.shoulder_elbow_wrist: Report individual left/right errors and limb direction angles; illustrative marker errors cannot independently prove anatomical match. Hidden joints NOT_OBSERVED.
pose_cues.waist_marker: waistband surface cue, NOT a femoral hip joint
pose_cues.centerline: waist/hip silhouette center scanlines tested independently of face and wrists

anti_cheat: OBJ is independently projected from camera matrix, ignoring submitted metrics and final-mask. Minimum projected width prevents shrinking to satisfy containment; state/mesh consistency needs separate runtime verification.
three_d_plausibility: Requires independent side/back visual review and genuine runtime/state/OBJ agreement; not inferable from 2D silhouette.
